name: @w6w-apps/tidio
description: Manage Tidio: contacts, conversations, tickets, operators and Lyro AI knowledge.

w6w.longDescription:
Tidio is a customer-service platform: a live chat widget, the Lyro AI agent, automation flows and a ticketing system. This app drives Tidio's OpenAPI from a workflow.

Create, read, update, delete and batch-write contacts and their custom properties; read a contact's conversation and viewed pages, and post a message as the contact; create, list, update, reply to and delete tickets; and look up operators, departments, ticket tags and custom fields. It can also list Lyro data sources and add a Q&A item to Lyro's knowledge.

The OpenAPI needs a Plus or Premium Tidio plan (the Products endpoints need a paid Lyro plan and are not part of this app). Analytics API and webhooks are separate surfaces and are not covered.
